verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to set or change the payout schedule. It also shows no per-payout breakdown of charges, fees and refunds. The only related mentions are that payout methods (direct deposit or PayPal) vary by country, and that an agent can 'check payouts' through MCP. Neither shows schedule control or itemized payout reconciliation, so they are adjacent features rather than delivery of this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
